title: W3Schools: Filter Words by Length
description: Given a list of strings `words` and an integer `k`, return a new list containing only the words whose length is strictly greater than `k`.
constraints:
0 <= len(words) <= 10^4, k >= 0
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(N)
starter_code:
def filter_long_words(words: list[str], k: int) -> list[str]:
    pass
solution:
def filter_long_words(words: list[str], k: int) -> list[str]:
    return [w for w in words if len(w) > k]
explanation: Filters words satisfying length condition in O(N) time.
